operations.summary: Create an alert for a thing. A thing must be locked before an alert can be set.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] create alert [PATH] alert when [PARAMS] condition key thing who [SCHEMA]

operations.summary: Get the alert attached to a thing.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] alert [PATH] alert for [PARAMS] key thing [SCHEMA]

operations.summary: Read the last 5 cached dweets for a thing.
Read the latest dweet for a thing.

operations.summary: Read all the saved alerts for a thing from long term storage.  You can query a maximum of 1 day per request and a granularly of 1 hour.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] stored alerts [PATH] stored alerts for [PARAMS] date hour key response thing type [SCHEMA]

operations.summary: Read all the saved dweets for a thing from long term storage.  You can query a maximum of 1 day per request and a granularly of 1 hour.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] stored dweets for [PARAMS] date hour key response thing type [SCHEMA]
